description: This file defines Express route handlers for project-related API endpoints in a backend server. It includes endpoints for fetching project name resolution, cost, usage, and cost history, utilizing various services and utility functions.

methods.name: round6
methods.description: Rounds a number to 6 decimal places to match normalization used in costs calculations.

methods.name: computeProjectCostUSD
methods.description: Asynchronously calculates total USD cost for a specified projectId using analytics.getCosts.

methods.name: buildUsagePayload
methods.description: Builds a normalized payload object with projectId, costUSD, credits used, and currency information.
